launcher: VelociraptorClient.launchHunt() — the path the dashboard's Sigma card uses

process.rule:
title: 802 live process_creation
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  sel:
    Image|endswith: '\svchost.exe'
    ParentImage|endswith: '\services.exe'
    Hashes|contains: 'a'
  condition: sel
process.vql:
-- Sigma "802 live process_creation" → pslist(): running processes only, not process history
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET ByPid <= memoize(query={ SELECT Pid, Exe, CommandLine FROM pslist() }, key="Pid")
LET Procs <= SELECT Pid, Ppid, Name, Exe AS Image, CommandLine, Username AS User, hash(path=Exe) AS Hashes, get(item=ByPid, field=str(str=Ppid)).Exe AS ParentImage, get(item=ByPid, field=str(str=Ppid)).CommandLine AS ParentCommandLine FROM pslist()
SELECT * FROM Procs
WHERE (Image =~ "(?i)\\\\svchost\\.exe$" AND ParentImage =~ "(?i)\\\\services\\.exe$" AND (Hashes.MD5 =~ "(?i)a" OR Hashes.SHA1 =~ "(?i)a" OR Hashes.SHA256 =~ "(?i)a"))

netPort.rule:
title: 802 live network_connection
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  sel:
    DestinationPort|gte: 1
    Image|endswith: '.exe'
  condition: sel
netPort.vql:
-- Sigma "802 live network_connection" → netstat(): open connections only, not connection history
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET ByPid <= memoize(query={ SELECT Pid, Exe FROM pslist() }, key="Pid")
LET Conns <= SELECT Pid, Status, Laddr.IP AS SourceIp, Laddr.Port AS SourcePort, Raddr.IP AS DestinationIp, Raddr.Port AS DestinationPort, get(item=ByPid, field=str(str=Pid)).Exe AS Image FROM netstat()
SELECT * FROM Conns
WHERE (DestinationPort >= 1 AND Image =~ "(?i)\\.exe$")

netCidr.rule:
title: 802 live network_connection
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  sel:
    DestinationIp|cidr:
      - '10.0.0.0/8'
      - '192.168.0.0/16'
      - '172.16.0.0/12'
  condition: sel
netCidr.vql:
-- Sigma "802 live network_connection" → netstat(): open connections only, not connection history
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET Conns <= SELECT Pid, Status, Laddr.IP AS SourceIp, Laddr.Port AS SourcePort, Raddr.IP AS DestinationIp, Raddr.Port AS DestinationPort FROM netstat()
SELECT * FROM Conns
WHERE cidr_contains(ip=DestinationIp, ranges=["10.0.0.0/8", "192.168.0.0/16", "172.16.0.0/12"])

file.rule:
title: 802 live file_event
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  sel:
    TargetFilename: 'C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe'
  condition: sel
file.vql:
-- Sigma "802 live file_event" → glob(): files on disk now under C:/Windows/System32/cmd.exe
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET Files <= SELECT OSPath AS TargetFilename, Size, Mtime FROM glob(globs=["C:/Windows/System32/cmd.exe"])
SELECT * FROM Files
WHERE TargetFilename =~ "(?i)^C:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\cmd\\.exe$"

registry.rule:
title: 802 live registry_set
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  sel:
    TargetObject|startswith: 'HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion'
    Details|contains: 'Windows'
  condition: sel
registry.vql:
-- Sigma "802 live registry_set" → glob(accessor="registry"): registry keys and values as they are now under HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE/Software/Microsoft/Windows NT/CurrentVersion*, HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE/Software/Microsoft/Windows NT/CurrentVersion*/**
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET Keys <= SELECT OSPath AS TargetObject, Data.value AS Details, Mtime FROM glob(globs=["HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE/Software/Microsoft/Windows NT/CurrentVersion*", "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE/Software/Microsoft/Windows NT/CurrentVersion*/**"], accessor="registry")
SELECT * FROM Keys
WHERE (TargetObject =~ "(?i)^HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows NT\\\\CurrentVersion" AND Details =~ "(?i)Windows")

mixed.rule:
title: 802 live process_creation
logsource:

  product: windows
detection:

  sel_network_ip:

mixed.vql:

SELECT * FROM Procs

SELECT * FROM Conns
WHERE cidr_contains(ip=DestinationIp, ranges=["10.0.0.0/8"])

-- Sigma "802 live process_creation" → glob(): files on disk now under C:/Windows/System32/cmd.exe
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET Files <= SELECT OSPath AS TargetFilename, Size, Mtime FROM glob(globs=["C:/Windows/System32/cmd.exe"])
